content:
=== Rsyslog Config ===
# MyApp rsyslog configuration
# Filter messages from the myapp program and route to appropriate log files

# Route all myapp events to app_events.log
if $programname == 'myapp' then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/app_events.log" fileOwner="myapp" fileGroup="myapp" fileCreateMode="0644")
}

# Route only ERROR level events to app_errors.log
if $programname == 'myapp' and $msg contains '"level":"ERROR"' then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/app_errors.log" fileOwner="myapp" fileGroup="myapp" fileCreateMode="0644")
}

=== Logrotate Config ===
/var/log/app_events.log /var/log/app_errors.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 myapp myapp
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload rsyslog > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}
